claims.text: Simultaneous wear and corrosion resistance in high-entropy alloys is governed by synergy between a mechanically robust refined microstructure and a continuous, adherent passive oxide film.
Optimized elemental partitioning promotes both microstructural refinement and formation of a protective passive oxide film.
The mechanically robust microstructure reduces material removal from abrasion.
A continuous, adherent passive oxide film suppresses corrosion-driven degradation.
(AlTiV)100−xCrx alloys can have a single-phase microstructure before tribocorrosion testing.
AlCrTiZrMo films can be prepared with a uniform, single-phase microstructure.
Changing concentrations of Cr, Ti, or Zr will vary the availability of passive-film-forming constituents.
An optimal elemental balance stabilizes a passive oxide film while retaining high hardness.
Increasing Cr content in (AlTiV)100−xCrx increases hardness while decreasing toughness and corrosion resistance.
Excess passive-film-forming elements may lower toughness and thereby enhance fatigue wear.
Insufficient passive-film-forming elements produce a discontinuous passive film.
A compositionally optimized HEA will have lower wear volume than a non-optimized baseline.
A compositionally optimized HEA will have lower corrosion current density than a non-optimized baseline.
A compositionally optimized HEA will exhibit lower total combined wear-corrosion degradation than a non-optimized baseline.
Improvements in deionized-water wear tests will be primarily caused by increased hardness.
Under corrosive conditions, a stable passive film further reduces both electrolyte-driven and wear-assisted material removal.
The proposed synergy should apply when mechanical wear and moderate corrosion occur concurrently.
The synergy may fail under negligible corrosion or under corrosion aggressive enough to destabilize passive films regardless of microstructure.

contradictions.description: Deionized water is described as a mild corrosive environment in the test conditions but is later treated as a wear-only condition with negligible corrosion.
